Software Engineer - Renter Experience

Software Engineer - Renter Experience

TheGuarantors is a fintech company helping multifamily owners and operators mitigate leasing risk while expanding access for renters. With a deep understanding of owner, operator, and renter needs, we believe renters deserve better access to the home of their choice and operators deserve greater protection and growth opportunities. That’s why we’re leveraging our real estate expertise and using AI-driven renter underwriting to help operators qualify renters faster while mitigating the financial risk of renter default. With $7B+ in lease value protected, we work with 9 of the country’s top 10 operators, are the #1 lease guarantee provider nationwide, and have consistently been named one of Inc. 5000’s fastest-growing companies, one of Forbes’ Best Startup Employers, and one of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500

The Role

The Software Engineer is responsible for owning a slice of the renter acquisition channel application and services, where most of our renter customers are onboarded. This role supports nearly every other technology team, as well as our operations and analytics teams by onboarding renters as smoothly as possible, while also maintaining data and process integrity for downstream teams.

The ideal candidate will bring a high degree of ownership, a keen sense for user experience, and persistent quality technical output. This candidate will be expected to translate abstract business requirements from multiple parties, operate within a thorough ownership environment, and strive to create the best possible outcome for all stakeholders.

Location
This is a hybrid role based in NYC

What You’ll Do
Own a slice of the renter onboarding and overall experience, from requirements, to development, through QA, deployment to production, and maintenance.
Execute day-to-day responsibilities related to developing new app/service features with accuracy, timeliness, and consistency.
Analyze, review, or maintain codebases, data models, and technical documentation to support business needs.
Partner with product, design, operations, analysts, and fellow engineers to support development priorities and ensure alignment.
Communicate updates, risks, blockers, and recommendations clearly and proactively.
Identify opportunities to improve team process and output, as well as stakeholder and user experience.
Use data, judgment, and business context to inform decisions and recommendations.
Manage assigned work independently and follow through on commitments, deadlines, and deliverables.
Ensure work is completed in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform other role-related responsibilities as assigned and aligned with business needs.
Requirements
5+ years of relevant production work experience in back-end web development, preferably using Go and/or Typescript
5+ years of relevant production work experience in front-end web development, preferably using React
Experience with large, interdependent codebases while maintaining business continuity.
Strong understanding of REST API concepts and designs.
Understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms, and experience creating and evaluating technical design documents
Demonstrated ability to manage engineering tasks, partner with product and design, and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic business environment.
Bachelor’s degree / Master’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to Have
Experience working in a fast-paced and cross functional environment.
Experience using Material UI’s component library.
Experience using GraphQL
Familiarity with modern web infrastructure components (e.g. caching, serverless, API gateways, etc) and how to manage them.

Benefits

Opportunities to make an impact within a fast growing company
Medical, dental, & vision insurance, beginning day one
Health savings account with employer contribution
Generous PTO and paid holidays
Flexible working hours
401(k)
Paid parental leave
Company sponsored short and long term disability
Flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, commuter)
Competitive salary

Base Salary

This is an individual contributor role, internally leveled as IC4 or IC5. 

The annual U.S. base salary range is $170,000–$220,000. Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits. Individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and other job-related factors, which will be discussed during the hiring process.
